platform: macOS 26.5 (25F71), arm64, Apple Silicon; debug build 08b291d with embedded frontend, WKWebView through the test bridge (src-tauri/src/test_bridge.rs)
method: One isolated instance on the pinned engine, one project conversation (first turn from the welcome screen). Text typed with Input.insertText, Enter as AppKit key events, the double-click as two trusted AppKit mouse events (clickCount 1 then 2) on the Send button, reloads with Page.reload. Counts read from the IPC trace (send_input, with its commandId), the stored transcript (user entries and their clientMessageId), the outbox key and the queued-turns key.

after.composer: Reply with exactly RELOAD-NOW-MV6GNSXQ and nothing else.

final.composer: Reply with exactly RELOAD-NOW-MV6GNSXQ and nothing else.

limits: IME not driven: the bridge has no composition input (Input.imeSetComposition is not served) and switching the system input source is out of bounds for this harness. The composer's guard is `if (e.nativeEvent.isComposing) return;` (src/components/Composer.tsx onKey; EmptySessionScreen.tsx the same). WebKit is known to deliver the Enter that commits a candidate after compositionend, with isComposing false and keyCode 229; if this WKWebView does so, that Enter would send. To check by hand with a Japanese or Chinese input source (Étienne).
The engine's session store (~/.local/share/muse/sessions) is the user's, shared by the test instance (ADR 0003).
Debug build in test mode, not the release build.
imeProbe: Input.imeSetComposition: Input.imeSetComposition is not supported by the WKWebView test bridge
